source: Seconds each unit test file costs a vitest worker (environment set-up, import and collection, then its tests), printed as the last line ([unit-timing] seconds) of the coverage job's "Report measured unit test costs" step on main CI run 41772773313 (4 November 2026, at 2c593da), GitHub-hosted runners with V8 coverage on and four workers per shard. Every one of the 1,956 test files was measured. Used only to balance the CI unit shards and to run each shard's files longest first; a file missing here counts as the median. Refresh it from that step's last line when the shards drift apart.
